description: This file defines the 'Request' class for managing JSON-RPC request messages within the WebSockets namespace. It includes methods to create requests, retrieve their ID, and serialize them as strings. The class also manages an atomic ID generator to assign unique identifiers to requests.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC request message with methods to create the request, get its ID, and serialize it to a string.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Default constructor for the Request class.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a JSON-RPC request with a specified method name and parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the request.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the request object into a JSON string.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for each request using an atomic counter.
